newsitem.title: USA: Excel says Ottumwa, Iowa pork plant closed Monday.
newsitem.headline: Excel says Ottumwa, Iowa pork plant closed Monday.

text.p: Excel Corp said its Ottumwa, Iowa, pork plant will be closed Monday and probably also will be closed Tuesday after a fire broke out late Sunday at the plant's loading facility, said Excel Corp spokesman Mark Klein.
Excel is a division of Cargill Inc.
"We are definitely not going to be running today and we probably won't be running tomorrow," said Klein.
Klein said it has not been determined how long the plant will be closed and hogs normally processed at the plant will be shipped to Excel plants in Marshall, Mo., and Beardstown, Ill.
The cause of the fire is under investigation. Flames were under control early Monday, but fire crews were still extinguishing small blazes, fire and company officials said.
Some ammonia was released late Sunday but was not enough to prompt evacuation of the surrounding area, Klein said.
The plant was vacant except for a maintenance crew late Sunday, and the maintenance people escaped without injury, said Klein.
Klein said it appears the fire damage was confined to the loading area, where processed pork is loaded onto trucks.
Klein said the plant slaughters about 9,600 hogs a day and employs 1,300 people.
